name: Nirmala Sitharaman
bio: Union Finance & Corporate Affairs Minister. Presented Union Budget 2026-27 in February 2026.

name: Amit Shah
bio: Union Home & Cooperation Minister. Key architect of the delimitation and internal security legislative agenda.

name: Shashi Tharoor
bio: Three-term MP from Thiruvananthapuram. Vocal opposition to delimitation bills citing Kerala's potential seat loss.

name: Rahul Gandhi
bio: Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha. MP from Wayanad. Led INC's campaign against the delimitation bills.

name: Kiren Rijiju
bio: Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs. Managed floor coordination for the delimitation and Waqf bills.

name: P. Chidambaram
bio: Former Finance and Home Minister. Leading INC's scrutiny of financial legislation.

name: Asaduddin Owaisi
bio: MP from Hyderabad, President of AIMIM. Led the most vocal opposition to the Waqf Amendment Bill.

name: Arjun Ram Meghwal
bio: Union Minister of Law & Justice. Piloted the three delimitation bills in Lok Sabha.

name: Mallikarjun Kharge
bio: President of INC and Leader of Opposition in Rajya Sabha.

name: Jayant Sinha
bio: Former MoS Finance. Chairs Standing Committee on Finance scrutinising the Securities Markets Code.

name: Piyush Goyal
bio: Union Minister of Commerce & Industry. Piloted the Jan Vishwas decriminalisation agenda.

name: Kapil Sibal
bio: Former Law Minister, now independent. Senior advocate at Supreme Court.

name: Ashwini Vaishnaw
bio: Union Minister for Railways, IT & Electronics. Steered DPDP Rules through stakeholder consultation.

name: Shivraj Singh Chouhan
bio: Former Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh, now Union Agriculture Minister.

name: Om Birla
bills: Presides over all Lok Sabha proceedings
bio: Speaker of the 18th Lok Sabha. Subject of a no-confidence motion filed by opposition in Feb 2026.
